metadata.description: Patrick's Claude Code plugin marketplace — a thin catalog of product repos.

plugins.name: mlst
plugins.description: A coordinated AI scrum team. The /build command orchestrates specialist agents (specification writer, scrum master, UI/UX designer, implementation engineer, infrastructure engineer, test runner, and code reviewer) directly from the main conversation, plus reusable skills for development workflows.

plugins.name: tech-debt-audit
plugins.description: Comprehensive technical debt and architecture audit skill. Three-phase methodology (discovery → signals → deep read) across Go, Python, JavaScript, Java, and Rust. Produces a structured markdown report with severity-ranked issues and a remediation roadmap.

plugins.name: proposal-team
plugins.description: A multi-agent team for writing and reviewing federal government procurement proposals. Includes specialized agents for compliance review, solution architecture, past performance, growth strategy, and subject matter expertise.
